invariants.rationale: Result is always an index in the glyphPositions array, so it's non-negative.

invariants.expression: x == (x + textOffset + fontOffset - style.font.getData().cursorX - glyphPositions.get(visibleTextStart) - ((getBackgroundDrawable() != null) ? style.background.getLeftWidth() : 0))
invariants.rationale: The value of x at return is a deterministic function of the input x and style/background offsets.
Result is always less than the number of glyph positions, representing a valid index.
Unless result is the last index, x is no greater than the position of the glyph at result.
